cases.name: testFilterInjectorAppliedToExistsSubquery
expect: SELECT * FROM `users` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `orders` WHERE `orders`.`user_id` = `users`.`id` AND `tenant_id` = 42) AND `tenant_id` = 42

cases.name: testFilterInjectorAppliedToScalarSubquery
expect: SELECT * FROM `users` WHERE `score` < (SELECT `max_value` FROM `limits` WHERE `tenant_id` = 42) AND `tenant_id` = 42

cases.name: testFilterInjectorAppliedToInSubquery
expect: SELECT * FROM `users` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `orders` WHERE `tenant_id` = 42) AND `tenant_id` = 42
